newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 7.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 7.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The state privatisation agency APV plans to sell all its remaining real estates, including ex-Soviet army barracks, in 1997.
- The state Pension Fund discusses on Tuesday the government's plans for the pension reform.

- The chairman of the Parliament's human rights committee said that government plans for allowing citizens to offer one percent of their personal income tax to non-profit organisations did not affect state subsidies to churches.
- The opposition party Fidesz proposed that a parliament committee should investigate the privatisation of Budapest Bank.
